testCases.title: Eval "refund-answer" when the first 2 calls to the provider end with HTTP 500 (http_500)
steps: Move eval "refund-answer-http-500" from plune.failures.proposed.yaml into plune.yaml and copy stubs/refund-answer-http-500.stubs.yaml to the same path next to plune.yaml.
testCases.expected: The run passes as eval "refund-answer" does: the client of plune run tries again and gets the recorded answer.
testCases.rationale: Variant of eval "refund-answer": the same prompt, data and checks, but the first 2 calls to the provider end with HTTP 500. The answer after the failure is the one recorded from the provider; none was generated. It shows how the eval's own model call survives the failure, not how your product does.
